messages:
anita: Follow-up from today's outage: recurring pattern is cold-cache decode spikes. Need short-term remediation + tests so we catch regressions earlier.

anita: Proposed actions:
- Prompt corpus from incidents (owner: @chris) due Thu
- Regression harness that compares warm vs cold latencies (owner: @paul) due Mon
- Load profile 'warm-to-cold' for k6 + nightly runs (owner: @tara) due next Wed
- CI gating proposal + exemption flow (owner: @anita) due EOD

chris: I'll pull logs and extract 60 representative prompts. Will tag each with seq_len, cache_hit_ratio, and a short note. Putting them under inference-evals/prompt-sets/incidents/182401.

paul: For the harness I want deterministic KV seeds so we can replay hot vs cold. Plan: add a flag `--kv-seed` and produce a JSON summary: {"p50_warm","p50_cold","delta_pct"}. Example run:```./regression run --suite cache_cold --artifact gs://redwood/incident/182401 --model redwood-v2```

tara: Load profile idea: baseline 100 qps, then 5s ramp to 500 qps for 60s, then rapid teardown to simulate eviction storms. Capture p50/p95/p99 and runtime queue depth. Will make profile runnable in CI staging and nightly long-run.

anita: CI gating: non-blocking by default. If delta_pct > 15% on P95 we create a blocking PR label that requires on-call ack. Exemption flow: `ci_latency_exempt` label + on-call approval in ticket.

chris: q: where to store KV snapshots? gs bucket ok? we'll need redaction for PII.

paul: gs://redwood-evals/incident-archives/182401 is fine. We'll include a sanitized sample and a quick script to spin up local dev env with the seed.

tara: note: ensure k6 runs don't exhaust infra quotas. I'll coordinate with infra and add a small ramp-up window.

ci-bot: Created tickets RINF-487 (prompt corpus), RINF-488 (regression harness), RINF-489 (warm-to-cold k6 profile).

anita: timeline recap: RINF-487 (chris) Thu, RINF-488 (paul) Mon, RINF-489 (tara) next Wed. We'll have a 15m sync tomorrow after standup to align on artifacts.

chris: filing PR tonight with first 20 prompts + metadata file.

paul: adding unit tests to harness and a sample output in the PR so the team can see delta metrics.

tara: scheduling a smoke burst in staging tomorrow 09:00 and will tag runtime oncall.

anita: thanks team. Please add checklist items to the incident follow-up board and link tickets. We'll revisit thresholds after first nightlies. :thumbsup:
